# AUDIO PROFILE: Lucía
## Friendly home cook from Madrid

## THE SCENE: A bright kitchen in Madrid, Spain
Lucía is chatting with a close friend at home while cooking, relaxed and smiling.

### DIRECTOR'S NOTES
Style: Natural, warm and conversational, like talking to a friend. Not an advert, not a radio presenter.
Accent: Castilian Spanish exactly as spoken in Madrid, Spain (European Spanish, with the Spanish "c"/"z" sound). No Latin American accent at all.
Pacing: Flowing and continuous, one sentence straight into the next with only very short pauses.

#### TRANSCRIPT
[excited, warm] ¡Yococino ya está disponible en App Store y Google Play! [friendly] Te prepara el menú de todo el mes, a tu gusto. Recetas caseras, paso a paso y con temporizador. Y la lista de la compra, hecha. [curious] ¿Has visto una receta en TikTok? Dale a compartir, elige Yococino… [smiling] y ya la tienes en tus recetas. [upbeat] Descárgala y pruébala gratis siete días.
